_provenance.upstream_operation: SHA MCT (standard and alternate version), 100 outer iterations x 1000 inner digests
_provenance.local_operation: the ACVP MCT loop driven through C_DigestInit/C_Digest (CKM_<hash>): SHA-2 standard MSG = A||B||C, SHA-2 alternate MSG = A||B||C truncated or zero-padded to the seed length, SHA-3 MD = SHA3(MD); every one of the 100 outer results byte-compared
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream files (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. The single MCT case of every SHA-2 (1.0) and SHA-3 (2.0) sample, with the full 100-entry resultsArray: standard-version MCT for SHA2-224/384/512-224 and all SHA-3, alternate-version MCT for SHA2-256/512/512-256 (the only MCT version those samples register).
_provenance.retained_fields: group: tgId, testType, mctVersion, hashAlg (+ local blockBytes, source_path/sha256/blob per group); case: tcId, msg, len, resultsArray (all 100 md)
_provenance.construction_note: Both MCT versions were reproduced for all 100 outer iterations of all 10 upstream cases with Python hashlib before the subset was cut (alternate: A||B||C truncated/zero-padded to the initial seed length).
